hits.snippet: # AGent Energy Raises $11M Seed AGent Energy raises $11M Series Seed round led by Spero Ventures and MassMutual Ventures to scale its AI-powered distributed power plant platform. AGent Energy Raises $11M Seed AGent Energy, a Houston-based developer of AI-driven distributed power plants, has announced the closing of an $11 million Series Seed financing round. This new capital brings the company's total funding to $17 million in its first 12 months of operation. ## About AGent Energy Founded in 2025, AGent Energy is led by CEO and co-founder Stephanie Hendricks.
